answer: Arrival-timing clustering. Each tx carries a hardware-attested timestamp from independent relays. Honest agents act at scattered times from real latency; a sybil farm spawns clones in synchronized bursts, since one operator drives them from one clock. Each epoch, auditors compute pairwise timing-correlation: a tight co-arrival cluster gets its influence decayed until each proves organic latency. Beating this forces per-clone jitter, costing real scheduling and relay fees. As a quill leaves uneven ink, identity is cadence, not key: no velvet oceantide of spawns can fake independent minds.
